description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations for managing mac80211 wireless interfaces, including setup, configuration, capabilities, and driver management within a Linux-based embedded system.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_setup
methods.description: Main driver setup function for mac80211, initializes configuration, interfaces, and processes.

methods.name: drv_mac80211_teardown
methods.description: Cleanup function for mac80211 driver, resets configurations.

methods.name: mac80211_check_ap
methods.description: Checks if an access point is present.

methods.name: mac80211_set_ifname
methods.description: Sets interface name based on prefix and type.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_vif
methods.description: Prepares a virtual interface with configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_iw_htmode
methods.description: Prepares the HT mode for wireless interface.

methods.name: mac80211_add_mesh_params
methods.description: Adds mesh parameters to configuration.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_adhoc
methods.description: Configures an adhoc wireless network.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_mesh
methods.description: Configures a mesh wireless network.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_monitor
methods.description: Configures a monitor mode interface.

methods.name: mac80211_set_vif_txpower
methods.description: Sets transmit power for a virtual interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_init_config
methods.description: Initializes wpa_supplicant configuration.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_add_interface
methods.description: Adds a network interface to wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration for wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: hostapd_set_config
methods.description: Configures hostapd for a physical interface.

methods.name: wpa_supplicant_start
methods.description: Starts wpa_supplicant on a physical interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_supplicant
methods.description: Prepares wpa_supplicant for interface.

methods.name: mac80211_setup_vif
methods.description: Sets up a virtual interface based on mode.

methods.name: get_freq
methods.description: Retrieves frequency for given channel and band.

methods.name: chan_is_dfs
methods.description: Checks if a channel is DFS (radar detection).

methods.name: mac80211_set_noscan
methods.description: Disables scanning for a specific interface.

methods.name: find_phy
methods.description: Finds the physical device for a given interface.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_path
methods.description: Renames PHY based on board configuration path.

methods.name: rename_board_phy_by_name
methods.description: Renames PHY based on board configuration name.

methods.name: list_phy_interfaces
methods.description: Lists network interfaces associated with a PHY.

methods.name: get_board_phy_name
methods.description: Gets PHY name from board configuration.
